# exact-cover recursive search fixed pieces; try no rotations
names=list(pieces)
sols=[]
def backtrack(remaining_names, uncovered, chosen):
 if not remaining_names:
  if not uncovered: sols.append(chosen.copy())
  return
 # choose most constrained placement by possible placements whose cells subset uncovered
 opts=[]
 for n in remaining_names:
  valid=[p for p in placements[n] if p[2]<=uncovered]
  opts.append((len(valid),n,valid))
 k,n,valid=min(opts,key=lambda x:x[0])
 if k==0:return
 rest=[x for x in remaining_names if x!=n]
 for r,c,cells in valid:
  chosen[n]=(r,c)
  backtrack(rest,uncovered-cells,chosen)
